svg.title: 2012 FDEP biological control and test sites at Dolomite on the Chipola River
svg.desc: The control reach is 83.8 to 177.4 straight-line meters upstream of current Outfall D-001 and lies along the current Baxter trust parcel river frontage. The downstream test endpoint is 96.7 meters from D-001.
svg.text: 2012 FDEP bioassessment sites at Dolomite / Chipola River
The control was upstream of D-001, but within the mine-side reach—not above the overall operation.
Distances are straight-line measurements from the current D-001 permit coordinate; river-channel distances are slightly longer.
Sources: FDEP corrected FYI Part II field sketches; 2025 FL0101192 permit; 2025 FDOR Cadastral layer. Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors.
Current parcel geometry is contextual and does not establish the 2012 title boundary.
